verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm an official CLI that reviews local, uncommitted changes before commit and can run reviews in CI/CD pipelines. The Claude Code integration shows another tool can trigger CLI reviews, but it does not establish a structured output format. missing for 10: explicit machine-readable output (e.g. a JSON or plain-output mode) that tooling can parse, details of CI-script usage such as exit codes or flags, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
